name: Uni-President China Holdings Ltd
summary: Uni-President China Holdings Ltd, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells beverages and food in the People's Republic of China. It offers instant noodles, tea drinks, juices, milk tea, coffee, bottled water, and bottle can drinks. The company also engages in the wholesale of pre-packaged food and dairy products, and forage and fertilizers, as well as manufactures and sells mineral water and seasonings. In addition, it is involved in the trading, leasing, real estate, catering, management consulting, and human resource management related activities.
